caseNameFull: McNeal v. Culver, State Prison Custodian
attorneys: The motion of the petitioner for the appointment of counsel is granted and it is ordered that Sam Daniels, Esquire, of Miami, Florida, be, and he is hereby, appointed to serve as counsel for petitioner in this case.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 362 U. S. 910, to the Supreme Court of Florida.
